$comment: SECURITY HEADERS for the public transparency portal (audit H-14).
This file did not exist, so the public site shipped with no security headers.
This is a plain static site with no build step and no login, so the policy can be
much tighter than the management portal's. Origins were derived from
fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com  the stylesheet and font files
www.googletagmanager.com  the GTM bootstrap in index.html
No rewrites block: this site is genuinely static (index.html + script.js +
style.css + robots.txt + sitemap.xml), unlike the mgmt SPA.
The CSP ships as Report-Only for the same reason as the mgmt portal — see the
comment in mgmt/frontend/vercel.json. Rename the key to `Content-Security-Policy`
to enforce; the value needs no other change.
Referrer-Policy matters here too: the portal is reached from QR codes carrying
?record=<docType>-<year>-<ref>, and there is no reason to hand that reference to
Google's font CDN or to any outbound link a visitor taps.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com https://drive.google.com https://drive.usercontent.google.com https://files-chhath.shaharpura.com https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com; connect-src 'self' https://chhath-public-worker.shaharpura.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://www.googletagmanager.com; frame-src https://www.googletagmanager.com; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
